en: A state that is neither-root nor non-condition is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is root and conditioned. (Abbreviated. Three [conditions] in the case of the object;
three in the case of predominance and decisive support. (The constructed is similar to the conditioned.

Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor non-visible, a state that is neither-root but visible arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three [conditions] in the case of root; three in the case of predominance … pe … three in the case of non-disappearance.

A non-causal, non-demonstrable state is a condition, by way of object-condition (*ārammaṇapaccaya*), for a causal, non-demonstrable state. (Abbreviated. Three [conditions] in the case of the object; three each in the cases of predominance (*adhipati*), decisive support (*upanissaya*), prenascence (*purejāta*), presence (*atthi*), and non-disappearance (*avigata*).

In dependence on a non-causal, non-reactive state, a non-causal, reactive state arises by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Three [conditions] in the case of the root; three in the case of predominance …pe… one in the case of mutuality (*aññamañña*) …pe… three in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor impinging, there arises a state that is neither a root-cause nor impinging by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: one; under predominance-condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor material, there arises a state that is a root-cause and material by way of root-condition. … Under root-condition: three; under predominance-condition: three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: three.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor immaterial, there arises a state that is a root-cause and immaterial by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: three.
Dependent on a non-root, non-worldly state, a non-root, worldly state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-non-root, non-worldly state, a non-root, worldly state arises by way of root condition.
(By calculation there are three; abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Conditioned by a non-root and non-supramundane state, a root supramundane state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root and not-to-be-known-by-anyone state, a root state that is to-be-known-by-someone arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-cause phenomenon that is not cognizable by anyone, a cause phenomenon that is not cognizable by anyone arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of the root [condition] … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance.
